# API outage retro

# What happened
- Outage, **cert expired**: The API was down for 47 minutes on Tuesday starting at 2:10 pm. The root cause was an expired TLS certificate on the internal load balancer.

# Fixes
- Alerting: The certificate-expiry alert went to an email list nobody reads anymore; certificate expiry alerts will move to PagerDuty starting this week.
- Renewal: Kim will automate renewal with cert-manager. The team should also audit the other 12 certificates this week.

## Summary
The meeting recapped an API outage that lasted 47 minutes on Tuesday starting at 2:10 pm, caused by an expired TLS certificate on the internal load balancer. The team discussed the missed alert and agreed to move certificate expiry alerts to PagerDuty starting this week. Kim will automate renewal with cert-manager, the team should audit the other 12 certificates this week, and the public postmortem will be written by Friday.

## Key Points
- The API was down for 47 minutes on Tuesday starting at 2:10 pm.
- The root cause was an expired TLS certificate on the internal load balancer.
- The expiry alert went to an email list nobody reads anymore.
- Certificate expiry alerts will move to PagerDuty starting this week.
- Kim will automate renewal with cert-manager.
- The other 12 certificates should be audited this week.
- The public postmortem will be written by Friday.

## Decisions
- Certificate expiry alerts move to PagerDuty, starting this week.

## Action Items
- Me — write the public postmortem by Friday.
- Kim — automate renewal with cert-manager.
- Unassigned — audit the other 12 certificates this week.
- Unassigned — move certificate expiry alerts to PagerDuty starting this week.
